# SI042 — deletion-or-overwrite-of-verdict

Verdicts must never be deleted or cleared.

## Why

Permanence is the product. A correction is a new round, never a deletion.

## Bad

```python
del self.verdicts[incident_id]
```

## Good

```python
self.verdict_history[incident_id].append(record)
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI042 -- reason
```
